scopeNote: Covers properties inside the City of Cleveland, as recorded by its Department of Building and Housing. Other Cuyahoga County cities (Lakewood, Parma, Cleveland Heights and the rest) keep their own permit and code-enforcement records.

violations.coverage: Cleveland Building and Housing violation notices, about 61,000 filed December 2005 to present.

permits.coverage: Cleveland building permits, about 202,000 issued January 2015 to present. The status shown is the permit's current workflow task.

source.name: City of Cleveland Open Data
source.currentRecordsNote: Violation notices and building permits are published by the City of Cleveland on ArcGIS; each record links to its page on the city's Accela Citizen Access portal.
